events.name: Conway Cars & Coffee
events.description: Conway Cars and Coffee is a casual monthly gathering for car enthusiasts held in the New Life Church parking lot in Conway. The event runs the first Saturday of every month and is open to all makes and models.

events.name: Bryant AutoZone Cars & Coffee
events.description: Cars and Coffee at the Bryant AutoZone is a free informal car meetup in the store parking lot, drawing local owners of all vehicle types. It is typically held the first Sunday of the month during the warmer months.

events.name: Ribs & Rides Monthly Cruise-In
events.description: Ribs and Rides is a monthly cruise-in held in the parking lot of RibCrib BBQ in Benton, welcoming classic cars, trucks and other vehicles of all types. Attendees can browse the vehicles on display while enjoying food from the restaurant.

events.name: Benton Cars and Coffee
events.description: Benton Cars and Coffee gathers all makes and models in the Blue Heaven Restaurant and Bar parking lot on the first Saturday of each month. Attendees can stay on for lunch when the restaurant opens at 11am.

events.name: Maumelle Cars & Coffee
events.description: Maumelle Cars and Coffee is a free monthly car meetup held in the parking lot of Jim's Razorback Pizza on the fourth Saturday of the month. The event welcomes auto enthusiasts of all kinds.

events.name: 27th Annual Wheelin' & Healin' Car & Truck Show
events.price_label: Free to attend; car entry fee may apply for show vehicles
events.description: Wheelin and Healin is an annual charity car and truck show held at Goodsell Truck Accessories in Jacksonville, Arkansas, benefiting a local animal shelter. The show draws a wide range of classic and modern vehicles for public viewing.

events.name: Northshore Mustang Club Annual Open Car Show
events.price_label: Free to attend; entry fee applies for vehicles entered in judging
events.description: The Northshore Mustang Club hosts its annual open car show at the Banner Ford dealership in Mandeville, welcoming vehicles of any make, model, and year. Proceeds from the events support scholarships for automotive and diesel technology students.

events.name: Cajun Crushers Car Show
events.description: Cajun Crushers of Louisiana hosts a public car show in Denham Springs with live music, jambalaya, and a 50/50 raffle. Registration for show vehicles opens at 8am ahead of the 10am to 2pm events.

events.name: Custom Cruisers Cruise Night at Esplanade Mall
events.description: Custom Cruisers hosts a monthly cruise night car show at Esplanade Mall in Kenner on the fourth Saturday of each month. The events raise funds for the Neurofibromatosis Children Tumor Foundation.

events.name: Cars and Coffee at NOLA Motorsports Park
events.price_label: Free entry; optional paid parade laps and track attractions available
events.description: NOLA Motorsports Park hosts a Cars and Coffee gathering in its main paddock with karting, mini golf, and food trucks available to guests. Optional paid parade laps on the main track are offered at the lunch break.

events.name: Delta Region SCCA Autocross
events.organizer: Delta Region, Sports Car Club of America
events.price_label: Autocross entry fee, pricing set at registration
events.description: Delta Region SCCA runs a public autocross event on the eight acre autocross pad at NOLA Motorsports Park, open to drivers of nearly any street legal vehicle. Entry requires advance event registration through MotorsportReg.

events.name: First Wednesday Car Meet
events.description: This gathering brings car enthusiasts together on the first Wednesday of each month at the Village of Providence town center in Huntsville. All vehicle types are welcome in a family friendly setting, and the series runs from April through October.

events.name: DVAAC 1st Saturday Cruise-In at Hoover Tactical Firearms
events.description: The Dixie Vintage Antique Automobile Club hosts a public cruise-in on the first Saturday of every month in the parking area of Hoover Tactical Firearms. Owners of classic and antique cars and trucks display their vehicles and spectators are welcome to attend for free.

events.name: Beignets & Brew Cars and Coffee
events.description: Beignets and Brew hosts a cars and coffee style gathering in its Rideout Road parking area in Huntsville. Local car owners bring a variety of vehicles while visitors enjoy New Orleans style beignets and coffee from the shop.

events.name: Tuscaloosa Toys for Tots Car Show
events.description: Unique Customs Car Club puts on this annual car, truck, and bike show in the University Mall overflow lot in Tuscaloosa to benefit the Toys for Tots holiday toy drive. Spectators can view a wide range of vehicles and are encouraged to bring a toy donation.

events.name: Filling Station Vintage Car Cruise-In
events.venue: The Filling Station Pizza Cafe & Bar
events.description: The Filling Station Pizza Cafe and Bar in the Crestwood neighborhood of Birmingham hosts a vintage car cruise-in on its property, drawing classic and antique vehicle owners for a casual midday gathering. Food and drinks are available for purchase from the restaurant.

events.name: Friday Night Cruise-In at Jack's
events.description: Car enthusiasts gather weekly on Friday evenings in the parking lot along Highway 72 West in Madison for an informal cruise-in and car meet. All types of vehicles are welcome and there is no cost to participate.

events.name: Big Shanty Festival Classic Car Show
events.description: An annual classic car show that fills Main Street in downtown Kennesaw with vintage and antique vehicles. The free, family friendly event runs alongside local vendors, live music and food.

events.name: Worship Roswell Cars & Coffee
events.description: A laid-back monthly cars and coffee gathering held on first Sundays at Worship Roswell. It offers a smaller, community focused alternative to the larger Atlanta area car events.

events.name: Peachtree Corners Festival Car & Bike Show
events.description: A classic car and motorcycle show held both days of the annual Peachtree Corners Festival at the Town Green. The free event runs alongside arts and crafts, live music and food vendors.

events.name: Just Track It HPDE at Road Atlanta
events.description: A one day High Performance Driving Education track day at Road Atlanta with run groups for novice through advanced drivers. Registration and a valid driver's license are required to participate.

events.name: Cars & Coffee Richmond Hill
events.description: A monthly gathering for car enthusiasts of all makes and models held on the grounds of the Richmond Hill History Museum. The events run the first Saturday of the month from March through October.

events.name: Polish N Parts Car Show and Swap Meet
events.description: A car show and swap meet held at the Daniel Field airfield grounds in Augusta, open to spectators and vendors of automotive parts and memorabilia. This is one of the CSRA area's regional swap meet events.

events.name: St. Augustine Cruisers Monthly Cruise-In
events.venue: Classic Car Museum of St. Augustine
events.description: St. Augustine Cruisers Car Club hosts a free cruise-in at the Classic Car Museum of St. Augustine on the third Saturday of most months, with music, door prizes, and a 50/50 drawing. The recurring outdoor event is sponsored by local area businesses.

events.name: Ponte Vedra Auto Show
events.description: The 24th annual Ponte Vedra Auto Show gathers about 200 classic and collector cars at Nocatee Station Field, judged across 25 categories. Admission and parking are free for spectators at this long running Ponte Vedra Beach event.

events.name: Middleburg Fall Festival and Car Show
events.description: The Middleburg Fall Festival and Car Show is a free community event in Clay County pairing a car show with food trucks, live music, vendors, and a petting zoo. It takes place annually at the Middleburg Civic Center grounds.

events.name: Clay County Cruzers Cruise-In at Tom & Betty's
events.description: Clay County Cruzers hosts a free cruise-in at the car themed Tom and Betty's restaurant in Orange Park on the second Saturday of every month, open to all years, makes, and models. Club members receive a food discount, and the events draw a regular local crowd.

events.name: Cars & Coffee Winter Park
events.description: A free monthly gathering of car enthusiasts held in the Full Sail University parking lot in Winter Park. All makes and models are welcome at this informal outdoor events.

events.name: Cars and Coffee Winter Garden
events.description: A monthly car showcase held in the Longhorn Steakhouse parking lot in Winter Garden on the fourth Saturday of every month. The free events draw a mix of exotics, customs, and everyday enthusiast vehicles.

events.name: Apopka Police Department's Horsepower for Heroes Car Show
events.description: An annual charity car show hosted by the Apopka Police Department featuring a public display of cars, trucks, and department vehicles. The events benefit local causes and are free for spectators to attend.

events.name: Flamingos & Fuel Cruise Night
events.description: A family friendly monthly cruise night held in the Flamingo Crossings retail district near Horizon West, welcoming any make, model, or year of car or truck. Attendees can grab food and drinks from the surrounding restaurants during the events.

events.name: Rock & Brews Cars & Coffee - Oviedo
events.description: A free monthly cars and coffee held on the second Saturday at Rock and Brews in Oviedo, open to all years, makes, and models. The pet friendly outdoor patio events include a complimentary cup of coffee near the entrance.

events.name: Kava Culture South Tampa Cars, Coffee & Kava
events.description: Kava Culture South Tampa hosts a monthly cars, coffee and kava gathering in the parking lot of their South Tampa kava bar, open to enthusiasts of all vehicle types. The events happen every second Saturday morning.

events.name: Jax Wax Cars & Coffee
events.description: Jax Wax Tampa Bay hosts monthly cars and coffee events in its Clearwater parking lot with a DJ, coffee, donuts, vendors and a best of show trophy. The events run every second Sunday morning and are free and open to the public.

events.name: Coffee & Classics Fort Lauderdale
events.description: Fuelfed hosts a casual Sunday morning gathering of classic European vehicles at Thrive Art District in Fort Lauderdale, held on the last Sunday of every month. The events emphasize driving classic cars as they were meant to be driven rather than judging them competitively, and registration is free.

events.name: Cars & Coffee in the Park
events.description: Cars and Coffee in the Park is a free monthly car gathering at Martha Rivers Park in Gastonia open to all makes and models. The events are held on the first Saturday of each month from 8 to 11 a.m. with easy onsite parking.

events.name: Matthews North End Cruise In
events.description: Matthews North End Cruise In is a free cruise event held on the last Sunday of each month on Park Center Drive in Matthews. The events welcome classics, antiques, late models, trucks and motorcycles with music, door prizes and food and drinks on site.

events.name: Indian Trail Car Show and Toy Drive
events.description: The Indian Trail Car Show and Toy Drive is an annual public car show hosted by the Crew Mustang Club at Indian Trail Town Hall. The 2026 events run from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. and combine vehicle displays with a community toy drive.
